verse.verse_1: No! I swear by the Day of Resurrection,
verse.verse_2: No! I swear by the reproachful soul!
verse.verse_3: What, does the human think We shall never gather his bones?
verse.verse_4: Indeed yes, We are able to shape his fingerstips yet again!
verse.verse_5: Rather, the human desires to continue in his immorality,
verse.verse_6: 'When will the Day of Resurrection be' he asks,
verse.verse_7: but when the sight is dazed
verse.verse_9: when the sun and moon are gathered together
verse.verse_10: on that Day the human will ask: 'To (which place) shall I flee'
verse.verse_11: No, there shall be no (place of) refuge.
verse.verse_12: For on that Day the refuge shall be to your Lord.
verse.verse_13: On that Day the human shall be informed of his former and latter deeds.
verse.verse_14: He shall be a clear proof against himself,
verse.verse_15: even though he offers his excuses.
verse.verse_16: Do not move your tongue with it (the Revelation) to hasten it.
verse.verse_17: It's gathering and reciting is upon Us.
verse.verse_18: When We recite it, follow its recitation.
verse.verse_20: Yet you love this hasty world
verse.verse_21: and are heedless of the Everlasting Life.
verse.verse_22: On that Day there shall be radiant faces,
verse.verse_24: And on that Day there shall be scowling faces,
verse.verse_25: so they might think the Calamity had been inflicted upon them.
verse.verse_26: But, when (the soul) reaches the collar bone
verse.verse_27: and it is said: 'Who is a healing chanter'
verse.verse_28: and when he thinks it is the time of departure
verse.verse_29: and when leg is intertwined with leg,
verse.verse_30: upon that Day the driving shall be to your Lord.
verse.verse_31: Because, he neither believed nor prayed;
verse.verse_32: he belied the truth and turned away;
verse.verse_33: then went arrogantly to his household.
verse.verse_35: then nearer to you and nearer!
verse.verse_36: Does the human think he will be left to roam at will?
verse.verse_37: What, was he not an ejaculated drop (of sperm)?
verse.verse_38: Then he was a clot of blood, then He created and formed him
verse.verse_39: and made from him two kinds, male and female.
verse.verse_40: What, is He then unable to revive the dead?
